map.安全快门速度计算器依据焦距估算手持不易模糊的快门（防抖可放宽），低于该值易手抖模: The Safe Shutter Speed Calculator estimates from the focal length the fastest handheld shutter that will not blur (stabilisation allows a looser limit). Below it, hand shake blur is likely, so it suits travel and low-light handheld shooting.
map.由焦距求手持不抖最快快门。: The fastest non-blurring handheld shutter from the focal length.
map.防抖级数放宽安全快门。: Relax the safe shutter by the number of stabilisation stops.
map.：50mm：安全快门 = 1/50s（分母≈焦距）；200mm 需 1/200s: At 50 mm the safe shutter is 1/50 s (the denominator is about the focal length); at 200 mm you need 1/200 s, and the longer the focal length the easier it is to shake.
map.：5 档防抖：安全快门 = 1/(50×2^5) = 1/1600s 理论可更慢: 5 stops of stabilisation: the safe shutter = 1/(50×2^5) = 1/1600 s theoretically allows a slower speed; in practice a compromise of 1/(focal length × stabilisation stops) gives 1/400 s.
map.存储卡可拍张数: How many photos fit on the card
map.手持最快快门分母≈焦距（全幅等效），防抖可放宽 2–5 档但非绝对，仍看手稳与姿: The fastest handheld shutter has a denominator about equal to the focal length (full-frame equivalent). Stabilisation allows 2-5 stops more, but that is not absolute; it still depends on how steady your hands are and your posture.
map.裁切系数要算吗？: Do I need to account for the crop factor?
map.要，用等效焦距，如 APS-C 50mm 等效 75mm 则安全 1/75s 更: Yes, use the equivalent focal length: an APS-C 50 mm being equivalent to 75 mm means a safe 1/75 s is steadier.
